story.zh: 玉的青灰压进纸的暖白里，冷而不寒。适合长时间读代码的白天。
story.en: Jade grey pressed into warm paper — cool without feeling cold, for long daylight reading.

story.zh: 窑火烧过的赭红，配粗砂纸的米色。像下午四点的书房。
story.en: Kiln-fired ochre over sandy paper — a study at four in the afternoon.

story.zh: 青绿与紫在暗底上散开，像高纬度夜空的一道弧。运动感最强的一套。
story.en: Teal and violet blooming on a dark field — the most animated set in the pack.

story.zh: 压到最低的蓝，只有状态色还亮着。夜里最不刺眼的一套。
story.en: Blue pushed almost to black, with only the states still lit — the quietest set at night.

story.zh: 粉只到「雾」的程度，干净、不甜腻，浅色下最好看。
story.en: Pink kept at mist strength — clean rather than sweet, at its best in light mode.

story.zh: 只有墨与纸。零彩色强调，边框更实、阴影更浅，适合做长时间对照阅读。
story.en: Ink and paper only. No chromatic accent, firmer hairlines and shallower shadows, for long comparative reading.
